entry.title: Hyeonji Jang’s Paper published in IEEE Access Vol. 14

entry.title: Paper presented at ICUFN 2026
entry.content: Minjun Choi presented his paper “Communication-Aware Adaptive Decentralized Traffic Signal Control via Broadcast gate” at 2026 Seventeenth International Conference on Ubiquitous and Future Networks (ICUFN) from July 7 to 10 in Milan, Italy.
